tools.name: about
tools.description: Catalog only — reading this is not an application. Call apply next with site_url, contact_email, publisher_name, and agent_name. Also covers the one-tag integration model, payout terms, and the full tool list. No authentication required.

tools.name: account
tools.description: View or update your account (authenticate with your API token sk_...; an approved account's Bearer web session — the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai — is also accepted, so do not ask the user to paste an sk_ token when you already have a working session). action: view (default; account and site status) | update (contact_email, agent_name, and/or google_email — set google_email when the Google account email on file already has an Ad Manager account or invitation; the application resubmits automatically within about an hour) | rotate_token (revoke the current API token and issue a new one; not available to web sessions — sessions rotate via https://rocketsloth.ai/recover) | replace_site (site_url: move this account to a different site; allowed only before the current site serves live ads or is sent to Google; returns the install snippet for the new site, which then goes through review again) | relink_google (ask Google to email a new Ad Manager invitation when google_connection says your Google account ended the link or declined the invitation; at most once per 24 hours; never automatic).

token.description: Your API token (sk_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

action.description: One of: view (default), update, rotate_token, replace_site, relink_google. replace_site moves this account to a different site (site_url required); allowed only before the current site serves live ads or is sent to Google. relink_google asks Google to email a new Ad Manager invitation when your Google account ended the link or declined the last invitation (at most once per 24 hours).

contact_email.description: For action=update: a new contact email.

agent_name.description: For action=update: a new agent name.

google_email.description: For action=update: the Google account email your Ad Manager invitation goes to. Set this when the current one already has an Ad Manager account or invitation.

site_url.description: For action=replace_site: the new site, as a root domain URL (e.g. https://example.com).

tools.name: ad_settings
tools.description: View and adjust ad settings for your site (authenticate with your API token sk_...; an approved account's Bearer web session — the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai — is also accepted, so do not ask the user to paste an sk_ token when you already have a working session). Pass resource and action; call with no action to see what's available. Rocket Sloth ad products: resource=anchor (sitewide sticky anchor: get/update enabled, position, expansion), resource=video_formats (get/enable/disable the floating outstream and universal video players), resource=rewarded (get enabled state, update the content lock).

token.description: Your API token (sk_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

resource.description: The resource to act on. Call with no action to discover available resources and actions.

action.description: The action to perform on the resource. Omit to list what's available.

params.description: Optional additional parameters for the action.

tools.name: application_status
tools.description: Check an application's status using its application token (at_...). While pending, your placed units serve Rocket Sloth house creatives; on approval the first call returns your API token (sk_...) exactly once and your units upgrade to full demand automatically — your page never changes. The automated review checks a pending site every hour but pauses 30 days after signup or the last check-again — pass action=request_review (pending applications only) to restart another 30 days of checks. If Google disapproved an approved account's site, fix the site and pass action=resubmit_site to send it back to Google for a new review; each resubmit doubles the wait before the next one is allowed. A Bearer web session (the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai) also authenticates this tool: the session is enough, no API token is issued on that path, and you must not ask the user to paste an at_ or sk_ token.

token.description: Your application token (at_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

action.description: Optional. Omit for a normal status poll. Pass request_review to restart the 30-day automated review check when it has paused (pending applications only). Pass resubmit_site to send a site Google disapproved back to Google for a new review (approved accounts only; each resubmit doubles the wait before the next).

tools.name: apply
tools.description: Call this first after connecting. Connecting the MCP server is not an application. Requires site_url (http/https; need not be live yet), contact_email, publisher_name (the site owner's name — not your agent name), and agent_name; description is optional. Humans can sign up at https://rocketsloth.ai/signup. Returns an application token (at_...). Call integration immediately with it. Rocket Sloth never asks for payment card, bank account, government ID, or health information in chat. No authentication required; rate limited per IP.

site_url.description: The publisher site to monetize, as an http or https URL (e.g. https://example.com). Need not be live yet — apply now, integrate while you build; full demand starts once the site is live with the tag.

contact_email.description: A contact email for the account. Used as the account login.

google_email.description: Optional. The email address that will receive Google's Ad Manager invitation later in the process; it must belong to a Google account the site owner can sign in to. Defaults to contact_email when omitted.

publisher_name.description: The site owner's name for the publisher account (e.g. 'Jane Doe'), provided with the owner's consent — used only to create the account and its Google Ad Manager invitation. Not your agent name.

agent_name.description: Your name (the agent/operator applying on the publisher's behalf), e.g. 'claude-code'.

description.description: Optional short description of the site or its content.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask the Rocket Sloth setup agent anything about integration, ad units, application, reporting, or payments. Pass the returned thread_id on follow-up questions to keep context. No authentication required; rate limited per IP.

question.description: Your question about integration, ad units, application, reporting, or payments.

thread_id.description: Pass the thread_id returned by a previous ask call to continue the same conversation. Omit to start a new thread.

tools.name: checklist
tools.description: Your onboarding checklist (authenticate with your application token at_... or API token sk_...; a Bearer web session from the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai also works — never ask the user to paste a token when the session already authenticates you). Returns every step to full-demand serving with its status (complete/pending/action_required/blocked), who must act (agent/account_owner/automatic), and concrete instructions, plus next_action — the single next thing to do. The same checklist is also embedded in application_status.

token.description: Your application token (at_...) or API token (sk_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: integration
tools.description: Get your exact script tag and ad-unit markup, plus placement guidance (authenticate with your application token at_... or API token sk_...; a Bearer web session from the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai also works — never ask the user to paste a token when the session already authenticates you). Available immediately after apply. Pass verify=true to fetch your site and confirm the tag and at least one ad unit are installed.

token.description: Your application token (at_...) or API token (sk_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

verify.description: When true, Rocket Sloth fetches your site and confirms the script tag and at least one ad unit are installed.

tools.name: payments
tools.description: View your payout status (authenticate with your API token sk_...; an approved account's Bearer web session — the in-page agent on rocketsloth.ai — is also accepted, so do not ask the user to paste an sk_ token when you already have a working session). action: settings (payout method name and threshold) | history (amount owed, this-month earnings, and payout rows). Read-only: payment method and tax setup are not yet available in Rocket Sloth. For help, email hello@rocketsloth.ai. Never send bank or tax details in chat or email.

token.description: Your API token (sk_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

action.description: One of: settings (default; payout method name and threshold), history (amount owed, this-month earnings, and payout rows).

tools.name: reclaim
tools.description: Free up a site that has an inactive previous registration. If apply says the site is already registered, use action=start to get domain-ownership verification options (DNS TXT record, hosted file, or meta tag), complete one, then action=verify with the method used. Once released, call apply again.

action.description: One of: start (get domain-ownership verification options) or verify (check that one method is in place and release the previous registration).

site_url.description: The site to reclaim, as an http or https URL (e.g. https://example.com).

method.description: For action=verify: the ownership proof method used — one of dns, file, or meta.

tools.name: recover
tools.description: Recover access when application or API tokens are lost. action=start with site_url emails a short-lived code to the account owner's contact address on file; action=confirm with site_url and code verifies the emailed code, revokes all old tokens, and returns a fresh application token (and API token if already approved). No authentication required; rate limited per IP and per site.

action.description: One of: start (email a recovery code to the account owner) or confirm (submit the code and receive fresh tokens).

site_url.description: The publisher site URL previously registered with apply (http or https).

code.description: For action=confirm: the recovery code emailed to the account owner's contact address.

Optional start_date/end_date (YYYY-MM-DD).

token.description: Your API token (sk_...). May instead be sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.

action.description: One of: overview (default), earnings_history, epmv_trend, demand_partners, top_earning_pages, ad_format_revenue.

start_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (optional; upstream default applies when omitted).
